figures.title: Where does the model lose reliability?
figures.caption: MED3pa profiles (leaves of the confidence tree), lowest confidence first. Arrow = AUC on held-out training-distribution patients → deployment patients in the same profile. Right: share of patients, Detectron verdict, and share of the removed subgroup inside the profile (deployment).

figures.title: Can disagreement classifiers tell deployment from training cases?
figures.caption: Detectron: CDCs copy the BaseModel, must keep agreeing on training-distribution cases, and try to disagree on deployment (Q_S) and reference (P_S^r) cases. Significantly more rejections on Q_S = harmful covariate shift.

figures.title: Localized or broad? Three injected shifts
figures.caption: The same pipeline with each subgroup removed from training. Left: share of patients in profiles where Detectron flags HCS (n flagged / n tested), and the population-level verdict. Right: population AUC.
